title: Shriram Finance Q2 profit jumps 59% YoY to Rs 3,677 crore on strong interest income, lower funding costs

title: Shree Cement profit falls 15% YoY to Rs 263 crore on higher fuel costs
summary: Shree Cement’s September-quarter net profit fell over 15% year-on-year to Rs 263 crore for the third consecutive quarterly decline. Revenue rose 24% and sales volumes increased 14%, but soaring fuel costs pressured profitability despite stronger premium product sales.

title: Jana Small Finance Bank Q2 profit jumps 127%, raises FY27 growth outlook
summary: Jana Small Finance Bank reported a 127% year-on-year rise in Q2 profit to Rs 170 crore, supported by business growth, higher margins and improved gross asset quality. The bank raised its annual profit growth guidance to 100%, while loans and deposits expanded.

title: Jindal Steel Q2 profit rises 21% as revenue hits record Rs 19,448 crore
summary: Jindal Steel’s Q2 FY26 profit rose 21% year-on-year to Rs 771 crore, while revenue surged 44% to a record Rs 19,448 crore. Higher steel production and sales boosted earnings, while adjusted EBITDA grew 33% and net debt declined sequentially.

title: BPCL Q2 Results: Net profit declines 21% YoY to Rs 4,863 crore, revenue grows 29%

title: RBI governor reiterates listing requirement for top NBFCs as focus intensifies on Tata Sons
summary: India's central bank governor said on Friday non-bank finance companies classified in the upper layer are required to list on the stock market, reiterating the Reserve Bank of India's stance on the listing of Tata Sons without commenting directly on the company.

title: Jio IPO breaks 12 records: Rs 4.5 lakh crore bids, highest applications and more
